decisions.reason: Black finishes are a durable bathroom design trend, and a finish variant of existing drainage products costs little to keep in the range.
Shower channels for seamless coverings answer growing demand for floor-level showers and have their own product page, which signals strategic importance.
Pump-assisted drainage is a niche solution for renovations where gravity drainage is not possible, so it complements the range even though it is only mentioned on the website.
A tileable floor drain fits closely with the firm's core drainage business and is featured prominently with its own page.
Stainless steel design grates are a core fabricated-metal competence with steady demand, and the product has its own page.
